title: Photo Duo 104 · 아워글래스 SSBBW × 애슬리트 USSBBW · 정면 + 3/4
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, the camera set close so the two of them fill the frame edge to edge, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subjects: TWO real adult women, both far beyond any real person in size, the left one standing square to the camera and the right one turned about 45 degrees toward her with the front of her body still mostly toward the lens and the great curve of her hips and rear projecting behind her, their two bodies together so wide that they overflow the full width of the frame and are cut off by the left and right edges, their sides pressed against each other and the flesh bulging out where they touch.

Left woman, square to the camera: a Latina woman in her late 20s, warm golden-tan skin with olive undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, a high ponytail tied with a cord. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — the one place on her body where the outline pulls inward. Below it a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, so much of it that it hangs far lower than it projects — sagging down toward her knees under its own weight rather than pushing forward, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, a gigantic rear, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms. Painted in Oaxacan alebrije — her own skin tone as the base, densely painted with neon magenta, yellow, lime green, turquoise and orange dots, stripes and zigzags, a bright striped band following every curve, no animal figures.

Right woman, turned 45 degrees: an East African woman in her late 40s, deep umber skin with a warm sheen, her face exactly the same tone as her body, a short cropped pixie cut. The body of a world's strongest woman pushed far past real limits: enormously broad thick shoulders, massive heavy arms so thick they cannot lie flat against her sides, a colossal bust, a huge barrel torso, no waist at all. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, so much of it that it hangs far lower than it projects — sagging down toward her knees under its own weight rather than pushing forward, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Colossal wide hips and a huge rounded powerful rear, tree-trunk thighs. The muscle is huge but rounded and buried under a thick layer of soft fat, broad blunt swells with no sharp separation. Painted in stained glass — glowing panes of ruby, sapphire, emerald, amber and violet fitted together by thick black lead lines, rose-window medallions on the bust and torso, the lead lines following every deep crease.

Both hold their arms clear of their bodies with a visible gap of background at each side. On both: real photographic skin with visible pores, creases where the flesh folds and faint stretch marks, no illustration finish, no CG sheen. The paint is pigment on living skin, distorting over every bulge and cracking where it folds, covering everything below the jaw with no bare skin left; their faces unpainted, the pattern fading out at the neck. Neither arm crosses in front of her own body or the other woman's, both faces toward the camera. Every fold keeps its own rounded outline with a deep crease between them, never one shapeless mass; arms, hands and legs in correct proportion. Both wear extreme platform stiletto heels with soles as tall as their ankle bones.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation photograph, taller than it is wide.
